helpdesk-ticket.description: วันที่22/01/2569 คุณโสภณ อินทร์พยุง HN-53787795 มีการเบิกผ่านระบบ e-his 3 เลขที่ใบเบิก ดังรูปที่แนบมา เมื่อตรวจสอบย้อนหลังใน โปรแกรมe-his เมนู SRR Pharmacy Dispensing sheet พบว่ามี 2 เลขที่ใบเบิกที่ดูข้อมูลได้ โดยเลขที่ใบเบิกที่หายไป ตรงกับรายการในคลัง ที่มีปัญหา คือ รายการน้ำเกลือ(SAP: 20002887)ค้างอยู่ในระบบคลัง ดังรูปที่แนบมา เนื่องจากจำหน่ายให้ผู้ป่วยใน โดยผู้ป่วยออกจากโรงพยาบาลแล้ว ส่งผลให้จำนวนคงเหลือในระบบคลังไม่ถูกต้อง จึงต้องการตรวจสอบว่าเกิดจากสาเหตุใด

helpdesk-ticket.description: Issue detected in Live environment. When a user retrieves data in the Performing Task function by filtering with Task Ordering Date or Category Number, the system takes a long time to display the results. If the user then requests to reprint labels, the system may hang and fail to print all the requested slide labels when processing a large number of them. However, when reprinting only a small number of labels, the process completes successfully without system hanging.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Performance Issue - Performing Task (RLTSAMCS)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Issue detected in Live environment.
  • When a user retrieves data in the Performing Task function by filtering with Task Ordering Date or Category Number, the system takes a long time to display the results.
  • If the user then requests to reprint labels, the system may hang and fail to print all the requested slide labels when processing a large number of them.
  • However, when reprinting only a small number of labels, the process completes successfully without system hanging.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Hi Adeahub,
Refer to the email from Irvin below.
Issue: $0 item (sample drug) was typed at EMB Pharmacy into Outpatient visit, and service code 73800034 was sent to OAS. Failed processing at OAS.
Expected result: For Outpatient visit (to send to OAS): Apply OAS Service Code setup for the item (for this item, would be PHANB). If no OAS Service Code setup, to send default code (which would be dispense code).
What is this system parameter ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE used for? Current setup is “E,O”.
Is there some reason for which we had set up to include "O" visit type in this parameter?
Pls help to investigate and reply with the finding.
Thanks.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: (SGH Maxcare Production Issue) Service code 73800034 sent to OAS for $0 item typed at EMB Pharmacy
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi Adeahub,
 
Refer to the email from Irvin below.
 
Issue: $0 item (sample drug) was typed at EMB Pharmacy into Outpatient visit, and service code 73800034 was sent to OAS. Failed processing at OAS.
 
Expected result: For Outpatient visit (to send to OAS): Apply OAS Service Code setup for the item (for this item, would be PHANB). If no OAS Service Code setup, to send default code (which would be dispense code).
 
What is this system parameter ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE used for? Current setup is “E,O”.
 
Is there some reason for which we had set up to include "O" visit type in this parameter?
 
 
Pls help to investigate and reply with the finding.
 
Thanks.

helpdesk-note.body-html:
created_by: 159006416289
time: 2026-01-31 20:32:06 UTC

helpdesk-note.body: As highlighted in the email, SGH has set the system parameter ‘DFT_ZERO_TRXORIDE’ to ‘T’ to override the transaction code for transactions with a sales amount of $0.00. In addition, ‘ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE’ is configured as ‘E, O’, which has impacted both A&E and Outpatient visits. This override logic is applied after the bill category filtering logic. If the store code ‘SGH_ZERO_TRXCPDE’ is not found in the mapping, the program will then proceed with the existing transaction code mapping sequence: OAS service code (as defined in system parameters and configured in the item master), followed by drug/dispensed code, and finally item codes. I am unsure why Outpatient is included in the parameter ‘ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE’. Please check with Huey Min for clarification. Currently, the following inventory stores have the SGH_ZERO_TRXCODE mapping configured as shown below. The reported issue is related to the EMB store, where the record was added on 19 Aug 2024. Based on the configuration, it appears that the EMB store is being used to dispense prescriptions for both A&E and Outpatient visits. If transaction code 73800034 is not the expected value for $0.00 outpatient transactions in EMB, a recommended workaround would be to create a new the bill category codes which align with the OAS Service Code and ensure the bill category is selected prior to processing this type of transaction.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
As highlighted in the email, SGH has set the system parameter ‘DFT_ZERO_TRXORIDE’ to ‘T’ to override the transaction code for transactions with a sales amount of $0.00. In addition, ‘ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE’ is configured as ‘E, O’, which has impacted both A&E and Outpatient visits.
 
This override logic is applied after the bill category filtering logic. If the store code ‘SGH_ZERO_TRXCPDE’ is not found in the mapping, the program will then proceed with the existing transaction code mapping sequence: OAS service code (as defined in system parameters and configured in the item master), followed by drug/dispensed code, and finally item codes.
 
I am unsure why Outpatient is included in the parameter ‘ZERO_ORIDE_VSTYPE’. Please check with Huey Min for clarification.
 
 
 
Currently, the following inventory stores have the SGH_ZERO_TRXCODE mapping configured as shown below. The reported issue is related to the EMB store, where the record was added on 19 Aug 2024.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Siti Norshuhada Bt Salled, Regards to this issue. Based on the screenshot shared (Patient List by Relationship > OP Visit), the End Consultation column shows empty data, indicating that the encounter has not yet been closed. Meanwhile, the configuration under CA Admin Setup > Relationship shows that OP Visit has an expiry rule that takes effect 7 days after discharge. As a result, the expiry rule for the OP Visit relationship cannot be applied because the encounter remains open. Consequently, users are still able to view the patient in this function. Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Siti Norshuhada Bt Salled,

Regards to this issue.

Based on the screenshot shared (Patient List by Relationship > OP Visit), the End Consultation column shows empty data, indicating that the encounter has not yet been closed.

Meanwhile, the configuration under CA Admin Setup > Relationship shows that OP Visit has an expiry rule that takes effect 7 days after discharge.

As a result, the expiry rule for the OP Visit relationship cannot be applied because the encounter remains open. Consequently, users are still able to view the patient in this function.


Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-note.body: **19/01/2026 04:30:12 - Muhammad Al-Fateh Jalal (Customer Visible Notes) Can you please confirm the Relationship selected by the users and the Expiry Rule defined for the Relationship.
helpdesk-note.body-html: **19/01/2026 04:30:12 - Muhammad Al-Fateh Jalal (Customer Visible Notes) Can you please confirm the Relationship selected by the users and the Expiry Rule defined for the Relationship.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Siti Norshuhada Bt Salled, Im putting this ticket as resolved. Based on observation, the relationship assigned was auto-defaulted by system during assigning the practitioner under OP > Manage Patient Queue. on top of that, the Relationship masterdata is a system defined data, where it supposed to be expired after 7days of discharge. due to both factors above, as patient's encounter has not yet closed, the system cannot immediately define the end date of the relationship as the expiry rule cannot be triggered. as a result, patient's encounter will remain available in the patient list by relationship Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Siti Norshuhada Bt Salled,

Im putting this ticket as resolved. 

Based on observation, the relationship assigned was auto-defaulted by system during assigning the practitioner under OP > Manage Patient Queue.
on top of that, the Relationship masterdata is a system defined data, where it supposed to be expired after 7days of discharge.

due to both factors above, as patient's encounter has not yet closed, the system cannot immediately define the end date of the relationship as the expiry rule cannot be triggered. as a result, patient's encounter will remain available in the patient list by relationship

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description: Dear Dedalus Support Team, We would like to report an issue encountered on the HSIScare mobile application related to the self check-in function. Issue description: A patient is experiencing an error when attempting to perform self check-in via the HSIScare mobile app. Findings from our initial checking: After verification, we found that this is the patient’s first visit to the clinic. As per the current workflow, first-visit patients are not allowed to perform self check-in using the HSIScare app. However, the application still allows the action to be attempted, which results in an error being displayed to the user. Request: We would appreciate it if your team could: Review the self check-in function logic for first-visit patients, and Confirm whether system validation or user messaging can be improved to prevent this error (e.g. disabling self check-in or showing a clear message for first-visit patients). Please let us know if further information or logs are required from our side for further investigation.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: HSIScare error checkin issue
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Dear Dedalus Support Team,
We would like to report an issue encountered on the HSIScare mobile application related to the self check-in function.
Issue description:
A patient is experiencing an error when attempting to perform self check-in via the HSIScare mobile app.
Findings from our initial checking:
After verification, we found that this is the patient’s first visit to the clinic. As per the current workflow, first-visit patients are not allowed to perform self check-in using the HSIScare app. However, the application still allows the action to be attempted, which results in an error being displayed to the user.
Request:
We would appreciate it if your team could:
  • Review the self check-in function logic for first-visit patients, and
  • Confirm whether system validation or user messaging can be improved to prevent this error (e.g. disabling self check-in or showing a clear message for first-visit patients).
Please let us know if further information or logs are required from our side for further investigation.

User would like to reopen this issue and have some follow up questions from your replies previously and have provided another sample visit.
1. As system not able process the cancelling message because it cannot find the related dispense message, why are the dispense messages were not received/processed by Maxcare in first place? It received both the cancelling and dispense messages at the same time. See the screenshot below. helpdesk-note.body:
Hi @Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe)<mailto:idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>
Re the follow up questions below, please tell me if the explanation makes sense or require more information. I’ll check on the other sample visit provided and update again.
1. As system not able process the cancelling message because it cannot find the related dispense message, why are the dispense messages were not received/processed by Maxcare in first place? [AdeaHub] MaxCare received both the cancelling and dispense messages at the same time. However, the dispensing messages were processed after the cancelling message. See the screenshot below. [How Tze] Why Maxcare failed process message ‘0001YPWBD’ below? [Win] The sequence / timing of the message being process determined the failure of CD message. In the case of ‘0001YPWBD’ CD message, it failed because it can’t locate the corresponding CG message (‘0001YPWBE’).
1. Possible to trace out these dispense message to see if Maxcare received them before their related cancel messages arrived? [AdeaHub] Yes, MaxCare did received the dispense message. It received both the cancelling and dispense messages at the same time. See the screenshot below. MIEServerService-SMM_RCV-SMXP_SMM.exe v335 to v379
INQProcessorService-SMM_INQ-SMXP_SMM.exe v320 to v385
SHSSMMInterfaceDLL.dll v363 to v382

ORDER BY  INKW_MESSAGE_ID, INKW_SCHEDULED_AT - this is the agreed fix to optimize the sorting.
 
 
Comparison: ORDER BY INKW_SCHEDULED_AT, INKW_MESSAGE_ID

  1. As system not able process the cancelling message because it cannot find the related dispense message, why are the dispense messages were not received/processed by Maxcare in first place?

[How Tze] Why Maxcare failed process message ‘0001YPWBD’ below?
[Win] The sequence / timing of the message being process determined the failure of CD message.
In the case of ‘0001YPWBD’ CD message, it failed because it can’t locate the corresponding CG message (‘0001YPWBE’).

[Win] The sequence / timing of the message being process determined the failure of CD message.
In the case of ‘0001YPWBD’ CD message, it failed because it can’t locate the corresponding CG message (‘0001YPWBE’).

MaxCare processed the DFTP03 dispense message.

Subject: SKH Maxcare - M002K273C4 - double charging and 1 credit for single mark task done, reposting CD resulted in cancellation of both CGs

Description:
SKH User noticed that for this case in PROD (8126305781C), upon reposting a CD transaction (SMM M002K273C4) on IE Message Viewer with the error message "Multiple FT1 .No  order found for return. PRN: "Sxxxx995F", Service: "0010- 40-024-K", Order date: "13-Feb-2026 13:04:54"", both original and duplicate CG transaction were found to be cancelled on Maxcare.
 
CG #1 (original, 882C) for M002K273C4
MSH|^~\&|SMMCHG|SKH|||20260213130432||DFT^P03|2026021313043294882C|D|2.3.1
PID|||PDPA|8126305781C
FT1|1|3||20260213130100||CG|0010-40-024-K^Potassium Dihydrogen Phosphate 10mmol/10mL Injection^SMM|||1.0000|0.000|0.000||||WQ69^0005^01^SKH^3g Conc Electrolyte (Intermittent)^||I|||70090H||M002K273C4^SMM||||ampoule||
FT1|2|3||20260213130100||CG|0009-40-029-L^Sodium Chloride 0.9% InFUSion Bottle 500mL #S^SMM|||1.0000|0.000|0.000||||WQ69^0005^01^SKH^3g Conc Electrolyte (Intermittent)^||I|||70090H||M002K273C4^SMM||||bottle||
 
CG #2 (duplicate, 900C) for M002K273C4
CD (899R) - reposted for M002K273C4
 
Both CG #1 and CG #2 cancelled after reposting CD for M002K273C4
Prior to reposting, both CG #1 and CG #2 had the status "Dispensed".
 
 
Another example they had encountered today and had not re-process the message in Maxcare after noticing both systems’ records are tallied.
 
Case/MM#: 8126306597B / M002K2L6Q4
SMM sent 3 charge, 2 credit.
 
Maxcare received 2 charge, 1 credit.
 
In Maxcare dispense window, showed 3 charge received and 2 got cancelled, which is tallied with SCM record.
 
 
 
Case/MM#: 8125353185A/ M002K2HYY6
SMM sent 3 charge, 2 credit.
 
Maxcare received 2 charge, 1 credit.
 
In Maxcare dispense window, showed 3 charge received and 2 got cancelled, which is tallied with SCM record.
 
 
Kindly investigate why reposting one credit charge resulted in cancellation of both charges and see if this behaviour is supposed to be correct when handling SMM cancellation messages.

Please be cautious.

Hi @Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe)
 
Re the follow up questions below, please tell me if the explanation makes sense or require more information.
I’ll check on the other sample visit provided and update again.
 
  1. As system not able process the cancelling message because it cannot find the related dispense message, why are the dispense messages were not received/processed by Maxcare in first place?
[AdeaHub] MaxCare received both the cancelling and dispense messages at the same time. However, the dispensing messages were processed after the cancelling message. See the screenshot below.
[How Tze] Why Maxcare failed process message ‘0001YPWBD’ below?
[Win] The sequence / timing of the message being process determined the failure of CD message.
In the case of ‘0001YPWBD’ CD message, it failed because it can’t locate the corresponding CG message (‘0001YPWBE’).
 
  1. Possible to trace out these dispense message to see if Maxcare received them before their related cancel messages arrived?
[AdeaHub] Yes, MaxCare did received the dispense message. It received both the cancelling and dispense messages at the same time. See the screenshot below.
[How Tze] Since Maxcare received both message at the same time as you’ve mentioned above, why one of the message failed processed as shown in screenshot below?
[Win] The sequence / timing of the message being process determined the failure of CD message.
In the case of ‘0001YPWBD’ CD message, it failed because it can’t locate the corresponding CG message (‘0001YPWBE’).
 
Sequence of Event when MaxCare received the DFTP03 cancel & dispense messages for 8126301808G / M002JS4Y5T
#
Date & Time
Event
1
14.01.2026 6:54:24 AM
MaxCare received the DFTP03 cancel message (‘0001YPWBD’) and dispense message (‘0001YPWBE’).
2
14.01.2026 6:54:29 AM
MaxCare processed the ‘0001YPWBD’cancel message before the ‘0001YPWBE’ dispense message.
Since it cannot find the related dispense message, it returns the error.
3
14.01.2026 6:54:30 AM
MaxCare processed the DFTP03 dispense message.
 
 
Best regards
Win
Adeahub Singapore Pte Ltd
Application Deployment Management Specialist

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Issue reported in version: Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe v376 Dispensing .exe v9.8.11.378
4. (Issue, for discussion) Detection of inconsistency between visit and transaction financial information for non-MAF drugs typed into Emergency visit (Affects Recalculate Charges function and Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe) For Emergency visit (Visit Type = E), SAP-ISH sends only MTSOC_MAF scheme and MAFxxx MT band (is not a default scheme, applicable only for MAF drugs) Type non-MAF drug (e.g. SDL1 drug) >> No MT band assigned, apply subsidy (if any) based on charge table and charge rule (which is regardless of MT band) – this is correct behaviour Because visit has MT band (MTSOC_MAF only) but transaction has no MT band, the transaction would be identified to have inconsistency between visit and transaction financial information (false positive), both at Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE and when user clicks Recalculate Charges If user proceeds to recalculate charges, the recalculated charges would still have no MT band assigned >> No change from before (this is correct behaviour), continues to show as inconsistency [30 Jul 2025] Jade: In this scenario, the drug is not MAF drug hence and it is expected not to show in the report. For other scenarios if MAF drug is dispensed and scheme is not applied (scenario where ADT sent the MTSOC_MAF scheme band after item added), is it expecting to appear in the Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE for this scenario? The program is not checking at item/drug level to which scheme it is covering. We have to discuss this if there is change needed. [Irvin 12/08/2025 1630 hrs] For this scenario, non-MAF drug is expected to not show in the report. For other scenarios if MAF drug is dispensed and scheme is not applied (e.g. ADT sent the MTSOC_MAF scheme band after item added), yes, the transactions are expected to appear in the report.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH UAT: Issue #4 - Detection of inconsistency between visit and transaction financial information for non-MAF drugs typed into Emergency visit
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Issue reported in version:
Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe   v376
Dispensing .exe v9.8.11.378
 
4.      (Issue, for discussion)
Detection of inconsistency between visit and transaction financial information for non-MAF drugs typed into Emergency visit
(Affects Recalculate Charges function and Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe)
For Emergency visit (Visit Type = E), SAP-ISH sends only MTSOC_MAF scheme and MAFxxx MT band (is not a default scheme, applicable only for MAF drugs)
Type non-MAF drug (e.g. SDL1 drug) >> No MT band assigned, apply subsidy (if any) based on charge table and charge rule (which is regardless of MT band) – this is correct behaviour
Because visit has MT band (MTSOC_MAF only) but transaction has no MT band, the transaction would be identified to have inconsistency between visit and transaction financial information (false positive), both at Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE and when user clicks Recalculate Charges
If user proceeds to recalculate charges, the recalculated charges would still have no MT band assigned >> No change from before (this is correct behaviour), continues to show as inconsistency
[30 Jul 2025] Jade:  In this scenario, the drug is not MAF drug hence and it is expected not to show in the report. For other scenarios if MAF drug is dispensed and scheme is not applied (scenario where ADT sent the MTSOC_MAF scheme band after item added), is it expecting to appear in the Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE for this scenario?  The program is not checking at item/drug level to which scheme it is covering.  We have to discuss this if there is change needed.
[Irvin 12/08/2025 1630 hrs] For this scenario, non-MAF drug is expected to not show in the report.
For other scenarios if MAF drug is dispensed and scheme is not applied (e.g. ADT sent the MTSOC_MAF scheme band after item added), yes, the transactions are expected to appear in the report.

helpdesk-note.body:
**02/09/2025 07:44:26 - Jade Lau (Customer Visible Notes) Email sent on Mon 18/8/2025 5:43 pm We have some discussion internally and confirm that the issue that user raised which is the scenario 1 will be fixed. Based on the FS, for the A&E visit, the VIS_MT_BAND_CODE is null. The transaction with blank MT band for this A&E visit should not be retrieved in the report as inconsistent when MTSOC_MAF is not set as default. Scenario 1: A&E visit with Non MAF drug is added Step 1: In Dispensing program, select a patient who has an A&E visit with MAF scheme band
**Step 2: Add the non MAF drug (manual entry or eRx dispense) and F7 the script Step 3: Run the Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe and the trx created in Step 2 found in the report. – Not expected result. Step 4: Retrieve the patient and the visit in Dispensing, do recalculation. The MAF scheme is not tagged to the transaction. – Expected result. Step 5: Run the Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe and the trx created in Step 2 still appears in the report. – Not expected result. However, scenario 2 will NOT be taken care based on original scope of the project. The current logic does not check the Scheme-Item Group coverage. It is a CR if to check the scheme item/group coverage and the change is quite major that would impact the performance. Scenario 2: A&E visit with MAF drug is added
**Step 1: In dispensing, select a patient who has an A&E visit without the MAF scheme band Step 2: Add the MAF drug (manual entry or eRx dispense) and F7 the script Step 3: ADT08 update the A&E visit with a MAF Scheme band Step 4: Run the Rpt_InconsistentFinancialInfoTransE.exe . Currently, the trx created in Step 2 found in the report. After fix #CUST1214313: The trx created in Step 2 will NOT be retrieved in the report. Step 5: Retrieve the patient and the visit in Dispensing and do recalculation. The MAF scheme is tagged to the transaction
**After fix #CUST1214313: The trx does NOT appear in step 4 but if users did recalculation in the Dispensing for this patient and visit/script, MAF scheme will be tagged to the transaction still.

While the complete reports are available in the EM (HIS) system, critical characters are omitted in the printed versions.
 
There is a discrepancy between the on-screen display and the printed reports, whereby information contained within scrolling sections is omitted during printing.

helpdesk-note.body: Please take a look at ticket #682 raised by Yong Koon Win (koonwin.yong@dedalus.eu).
helpdesk-note.body-html: Please take a look at ticket #682 raised by Yong Koon Win (koonwin.yong@dedalus.eu).

helpdesk-note.body: Please see the findings & workaround on the Substitute Order button not enabled. The PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’ instead of ‘P’ when the intervened drug was partially dispensed. I could not find the cause for the PSIN_STATUS not updated to ‘P’ after it was partially dispensed. Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button . The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Please see the findings & workaround on the Substitute Order button not enabled.
 
The PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’ instead of ‘P’ when the intervened drug was partially dispensed.
I could not find the cause for the PSIN_STATUS not updated to ‘P’ after it was partially dispensed.
 
Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button .
 
The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg> Sent: Tuesday, 27 January 2026 3:25 pm To: Yong Koon Win <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co>; Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg> Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare Hi Alex, Am I right to say that if PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’, the substitution order button will be disable and if the status is ‘P’ then the substitution order button will be enable? What is the transaction that is performed that will have the PSIN_STATUS captured as ‘N’ and ‘P’? Hi Liping, Can we confirmed that this case is a partial dispense transaction? Does this issue (substitute not enable) happened to other partial dispensed case? If no, are you able to share how this case is being dispensed to help on the finding of the cause that affecting the enable/disable of the substitution order button? Is the drug dispensed in fully then change to partial dispensed? Current Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button . Cause: The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg> 
 Sent: Tuesday, 27 January 2026 3:25 pm
 To: Yong Koon Win <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co>; Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg>
 Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>
 Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare
 
Hi Alex,
 
Am I right to say that if PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’, the substitution order button will be disable and if the status is ‘P’ then the substitution order button will be enable?
 
What is the transaction that is performed that will have the PSIN_STATUS captured as ‘N’ and ‘P’?
 
 
Hi Liping,
 
Can we confirmed that this case is a partial dispense transaction?
 
Does this issue (substitute not enable) happened to other partial dispensed case?
 
If no, are you able to share how this case is being dispensed to help on the finding of the cause that affecting the enable/disable of the substitution order button? Is the drug dispensed in fully then change to partial dispensed?
 
Current Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button .
 
Cause: The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg> Sent: Tuesday, January 27, 2026 3:35 PM To: Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>; Yong Koon Win <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg> Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare Dear Wei may, Can we confirmed that this case is a partial dispense transaction? Yes Does this issue (substitute not enable) happened to other partial dispensed case? No If no, are you able to share how this case is being dispensed to help on the finding of the cause that affecting the enable/disable of the substitution order button? Is the drug dispensed in fully then change to partial dispensed? This drug was partial dispensed and then when the old item code expired, we needed to substitute the item to dispense it but not able to as the substitute button is greyed out. Current Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button . Cause: The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.

From: Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg>

 Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare
 
Dear Wei may,
 
Can we confirmed that this case is a partial dispense transaction? Yes
 
Does this issue (substitute not enable) happened to other partial dispensed case? No
 
If no, are you able to share how this case is being dispensed to help on the finding of the cause that affecting the enable/disable of the substitution order button? Is the drug dispensed in fully then change to partial dispensed?
This drug was partial dispensed and then when the old item code expired, we needed to substitute the item to dispense it but not able to as the substitute button is greyed out.
 
Current Workaround: To patch the PSIN_STATUS to ‘P’ to enable the Substitute Order button .
 
Cause: The intervened drug has been partially dispensed, but the PSIN_STATUS column is not updated to ‘P’.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Yong Koon Win Sent: Wednesday, January 28, 2026 6:01 PM To: Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg>; Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co> Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg> Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare Hi @Er Wei May (Synapxe) Re your questions below, Am I right to say that if PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’, the substitution order button will be disable and if the status is ‘P’ then the substitution order button will be enable? [Win] Yes. What is the transaction that is performed that will have the PSIN_STATUS captured as ‘N’ and ‘P’? [Win] PSIN_STATUS = ‘N’ when there’s a new intervention, PSIN_STATUS = ‘P’ when the intervened order is partially dispensed.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Yong Koon Win 
 Sent: Wednesday, January 28, 2026 6:01 PM
 To: Chen Liping (NHCS) <chen.liping@nhcs.com.sg>; Er Wei May (Synapxe) <er.wei.may@synapxe.sg>; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team <adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co>
 Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) <rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg>; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) <prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg>; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) <idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg>
 Subject: RE: CUST1395720 - NHCS Maxcare: SR3375882 / IN1436452 : Unable to substitute order in Maxcare
 
Hi @Er Wei May (Synapxe)
 
Re your questions below,
 
Am I right to say that if PSIN_STATUS is ‘N’, the substitution order button will be disable and if the status is ‘P’ then the substitution order button will be enable?
[Win] Yes.
 
What is the transaction that is performed that will have the PSIN_STATUS captured as ‘N’ and ‘P’?
[Win] PSIN_STATUS = ‘N’ when there’s a new intervention, PSIN_STATUS = ‘P’ when the intervened order is partially dispensed.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com> Sent: Tuesday, September 9, 2025 2:21 PM To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com> Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com> Subject: RE: MST0106672 - SKH Maxcare: Script Search Slowness Hi Alex, After reviewing the DispensingSQLTrace10280.log file you shared, we observed that no values are set for the following system parameters, which are intended to enhance query execution performance: SCRIPTQRYI_ORAHINT SCRIPTQRYII_ORAHINT SCRIPTQRYIII_ORAHINT When the SCRIPTSEARCH_ALT_QRY system parameter is set to TRUE, it checks the above three parameters to apply the specified SQL hints for performance improvement. However, if these parameters are not defined, then the value of SCRIPTSEARCH_ALT_QRY (whether TRUE or FALSE) has no effect. This issue was initially reported and resolved for the SGH client. Could you please check what type of hints are configured for the above three system parameters? These system parameters (hints) are specifically used to optimize SQL performance during runtime.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com> 
 Sent: Tuesday, September 9, 2025 2:21 PM
 To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com>
 Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com>
 Subject: RE: MST0106672 - SKH Maxcare: Script Search Slowness
 
Hi Alex,
 
After reviewing the DispensingSQLTrace10280.log file you shared, we observed that no values are set for the following system parameters, which are intended to enhance query execution performance:
 
SCRIPTQRYI_ORAHINT
SCRIPTQRYII_ORAHINT
SCRIPTQRYIII_ORAHINT
 
When the SCRIPTSEARCH_ALT_QRY system parameter is set to TRUE, it checks the above three parameters to apply the specified SQL hints for performance improvement. However, if these parameters are not defined, then the value of SCRIPTSEARCH_ALT_QRY (whether TRUE or FALSE) has no effect.
 
This issue was initially reported and resolved for the SGH client. Could you please check what type of hints are configured for the above three system parameters?
 
These system parameters (hints) are specifically used to optimize SQL performance during runtime.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com> Sent: Tuesday, 9 September 2025 5:37 pm To: Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com> Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com> Subject: RE: MST0106672 - SKH Maxcare: Script Search Slowness Hello @Nagarathinam Ramesh Re “what type of hints are configured for the above three system parameters?”, please find the system parameters with the ‘%ORA%’ character for the SKH client.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com> 
 Sent: Tuesday, 9 September 2025 5:37 pm

 Subject: RE: MST0106672 - SKH Maxcare: Script Search Slowness
 
Hello @Nagarathinam Ramesh
 
Re “what type of hints are configured for the above three system parameters?”, please find the system parameters with the ‘%ORA%’ character for the SKH client.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Jade Lau <jlau32@dedalus.com> Sent: 09 September 2025 15:32 To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com>; Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com> Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com> Subject: RE: MST0106672 - SKH Maxcare: Script Search Slowness Hi Naga, These 3 parameters were not released officially by development. I don’t think we set this in SGH as well. The query were optimize that time and indexes were added in the past when similar slowness was reported. I remember it was created just in case there is slowness after all been done, then we can use the hint and do not need to release new program. It is similar to what has been done for the queries pharmacy worklist program. Please help to check what values to be set to improve the performance. SCRIPTQRYI_ORAHINT SCRIPTQRYII_ORAHINT SCRIPTQRYIII_ORAHINT

These 3 parameters were not released officially by development.  I don’t think we set this in SGH as well.  The query were optimize that time and indexes were added in the past when similar slowness was reported. I remember it was created just in case there is slowness after all been done, then we can use the hint and do not need to release new program.  It is similar to what has been done for the queries pharmacy worklist program.   
 
Please help to check what values to be set to improve the performance.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
This issue is related to MST0088788 / CUST0919019 Futured inpatient visit, what should be allowed and the related parameter CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS.
The fix requires for this log is when CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS is set to 'F' : - To implement fix to restrict dispensing from the prescription tab when users attempt to dispense to a future-dated inpatient visit. Prompt message ‘No Inpatient Detail available for current time – dd/mm/yyyy hh:mi:ss. Dispensing drugs for this visit is not allowed.’
Visit Type
Visit Date
Action
Current
Expected behaviour Please evalaute if CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS is the appropriate system parameter, as not sure if it affects other behaviours. If using CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS: No change to all other existing behaviours controlled by this system parameter
If parameter set as ‘F’ or the parameter is not set
If parameter set as ‘T’
Inpatient
After today (Future visit date)
Is usually secondary to issue where Preadmit visit created at Maxcare – is usually not supposed to have visit created (the reason for which to be investigated separately) Combined with workstation having VISIT_TYPE = ‘I’ + the behaviour to open the latest Inpatient visit upon keying in patient MRN, this means that if patient has a future-dated visit, the default visit opened is this future-dated visit, which is NOT the intended visit to be dispensed into. For setting of Inpatient visit (at Discharge Pharmacy): Intent is to dispense into the same visit where discharge medications are prescribed from. Dispensing into future-dated visit (different from prescribing visit) is usually NOT intended User would assume that the default visit opened (latest visit) would be the current visit that patient is actually admitted under Due to prompt fatigue, very likely to ignore prompt asking whether to dispense into current visit (incorrect) or prescribing visit (correct), and click Yes to dispense into current visit (incorrect)
Dispense from Prescription tab to Dispensing tab
Enabled
Disabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- We will fix this. To disallow dispense from prescription tab if the visit is future visit.
Enabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Manual entry at Dispensing Tab
Disabled
Disabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Enabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Undo dispense (Ctrl-U or Ctrl-Alt-U)
Disabled
Disabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- after we fix the above to restrict dispense from prescription tab, this will not be available. All buttons in dispensing tab is no enabled by default currently.
Enabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Delete transaction from dispensing tab
Disabled
Disabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Enabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Delete transaction from F9 screen
Enabled
Disabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- This fix delivered v380, this is expected result.
Enabled Jade 11 Nov 2025 :- When parameter is set, this is expected result.
Implication is that if user inadvertently dispenses from Prescription tab to Dispensing tab, and into future-dated visit (see comments to the left on why), user cannot reverse this process.
To achieve consistency on whether the 5 actions are enabled or disabled
On or before today
No change from current (All 5 actions enabled)
<Other visit types>
<Any>
No change from current (E.g. for Outpatient visit, all 5 actions enabled including for future visit date)
it

helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
This issue is related to MST0088788 / CUST0919019 
Futured inpatient visit, what should be allowed and the related parameter CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS.
 
The fix requires for this log is when CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS is set to 'F' : -  To implement fix to restrict dispensing from the prescription tab when users attempt to dispense to a future-dated inpatient visit. Prompt message ‘No Inpatient Detail available for current time – dd/mm/yyyy hh:mi:ss. Dispensing drugs for this visit is not allowed.’
 
Visit Type
Visit Date
Action
Current
Expected behaviour
  • Please evalaute if CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS is the appropriate system parameter, as not sure if it affects other behaviours.
  • If using CHK_VISIT_ACT_STATUS:
    No change to all other existing behaviours controlled by this system parameter
If parameter set as ‘F’ or the parameter is not set
If parameter set as ‘T’
Inpatient
After today
(Future visit date)
 
  • Is usually secondary to issue where Preadmit visit created at Maxcare – is usually not supposed to have visit created (the reason for which to be investigated separately)
  • Combined with workstation having VISIT_TYPE = ‘I’ + the behaviour to open the latest Inpatient visit upon keying in patient MRN, this means that if patient has a future-dated visit, the default visit opened is this future-dated visit, which is NOT the intended visit to be dispensed into.
  • For setting of Inpatient visit (at Discharge Pharmacy):
    • Intent is to dispense into the same visit where discharge medications are prescribed from. Dispensing into future-dated visit (different from prescribing visit) is usually NOT intended
    • User would assume that the default visit opened (latest visit) would be the current visit that patient is actually admitted under
    • Due to prompt fatigue, very likely to ignore prompt asking whether to dispense into current visit (incorrect) or prescribing visit (correct), and click Yes to dispense into current visit (incorrect)

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Utilization qty is showing 1 but utilized amount against that service is showing 0.
Steps followed are mentioned below Firstly, I’ve changed Approval limit to 1,20,000 and taken the printout (LBBC000052) was outside the 1st package (DATED- 5 DEC 2025 To 8 DEC 2025)- Attachment named 1 Then I’ve added some pharmacy and second package (DATED- 11 DEC 2025 To 4 JAN 2026)­­­­­ Then I’ve taken the print, and LBBC000052 was still outside. – Attachment named 2 Then I’ve changed PH limit of 2nd package from 5000 to 800 then LBBC000052 is going inside package. – Attachment named 3 The same can be observed from Maintain treatment package, where if we keep PH limit of 2nd package to 5000 which is defined LBBC000052 will be outside package but on Maintain treatment package screen – utilized qty will be shown 1 but utilized amount against that service will be 0, which is the issue now.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3035: Issue in utilization amount in Maintain treatment package and patient bill
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Utilization qty is showing 1 but utilized amount against that service is showing 0.
 
Steps followed are mentioned below
Firstly, I’ve changed Approval limit to 1,20,000 and taken the printout (LBBC000052) was outside the 1st package (DATED- 5 DEC 2025 To 8 DEC 2025)- Attachment named 1
Then I’ve added some pharmacy and second package (DATED- 11 DEC 2025 To 4 JAN 2026)­­­­­
Then I’ve taken the print, and LBBC000052 was still outside. – Attachment named 2
Then I’ve changed PH limit of 2nd package from 5000 to 800 then LBBC000052 is going inside package. – Attachment named 3
The same can be observed from Maintain treatment package, where if we keep PH limit of 2nd package to 5000 which is defined LBBC000052 will be outside package but on Maintain treatment package screen – utilized qty will be shown 1 but utilized amount against that service will be 0, which is the issue now.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
SGH User reported the case below:
User at Courier Service Pharmacy reports of two separate cases (both on 22/06/2025) where RDE message to OPAS (Fastrak) failed processing at Fastrak, resulting in no drugs added to queue number at Fastrak >> No labels printed. For both cases, the RDE message contains transaction for Delivery Fee from an earlier visit >30 days ago. Fastrak fails processing for message if it contains transaction with transaction date >30 days ago.
Kindly refer to screenshots and messages extracted in attached file.
Noticed the following for both cases: The transaction for Delivery Fee (0099-99-900-Z) under the previous visit (>30 days ago) had Status = Dispensed-Interfaced. This is not expected based on user workflow for typing for courier service cases at the pharmacy: Workstation is set up with AUTO_CONFIRM_F7 = F (follow System value) User types drugs (dispense over from e-Rx), then manual type Delivery Fee (0099-99-900-Z) User than selects drugs only (exclude Delivery Fee) and click “Confirm” >> Only drugs have Status = Dispensed, Delivery Fee should have Status = Prepared User then F7 >> Only drugs (but not Delivery Fee) sent to Fastrak in RDE message Both drugs typed under today’s visit, and Delivery Fee typed under previous visit, were under the same e-Rx script number. Not sure if issue occurs only when they have same script number.
Kindly assist to trace and investigate regarding the transaction for Delivery Fee from previous visit: Why its Status is Dispensed-Interfaced When / at which workstation / how the Status was changed (presumably from Status = Prepared-Interfaced), when user is not expected to change this Why the transaction was added to RDE message for drugs under a different visit
helpdesk-ticket.subject: (SGH Maxcare Production) Transaction for Delivery Fee from visit more than 30 days ago added to RDE message to OPAS (Fastrak)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
SGH User reported the case below:
 
User at Courier Service Pharmacy reports of two separate cases (both on 22/06/2025) where RDE message to OPAS (Fastrak) failed processing at Fastrak, resulting in no drugs added to queue number at Fastrak >> No labels printed.
For both cases, the RDE message contains transaction for Delivery Fee from an earlier visit >30 days ago. Fastrak fails processing for message if it contains transaction with transaction date >30 days ago.
 
Kindly refer to screenshots and messages extracted in attached file.
 
Noticed the following for both cases:
  • The transaction for Delivery Fee (0099-99-900-Z) under the previous visit (>30 days ago) had Status = Dispensed-Interfaced.
    This is not expected based on user workflow for typing for courier service cases at the pharmacy:
    • Workstation is set up with AUTO_CONFIRM_F7 = F (follow System value)
    • User types drugs (dispense over from e-Rx), then manual type Delivery Fee (0099-99-900-Z)
    • User than selects drugs only (exclude Delivery Fee) and click “Confirm” >> Only drugs have Status = Dispensed, Delivery Fee should have Status = Prepared
    • User then F7 >> Only drugs (but not Delivery Fee) sent to Fastrak in RDE message
  • Both drugs typed under today’s visit, and Delivery Fee typed under previous visit, were under the same e-Rx script number.
    Not sure if issue occurs only when they have same script number.
 
Kindly assist to trace and investigate regarding the transaction for Delivery Fee from previous visit:
  • Why its Status is Dispensed-Interfaced
  • When / at which workstation / how the Status was changed (presumably from Status = Prepared-Interfaced), when user is not expected to change this
  • Why the transaction was added to RDE message for drugs under a different visit

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Reporting an issue with the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program.
Client Code: SKH Program: ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe Program version: 9.8.11.349 Issue Priority: Medium Master Ticket #:
Issue Description When tracing the adding new record error in the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program, it takes around 35 minutes to complete the tracer. There are 555 records in the ITEM_CI_SCHEME.
Also, the error (ICIS_REFNO not unique) was not clearly included in the tracer log. To replicate this error: a. Manually insert a ICIS_REFNO which is lesser than/within the MX_ICISREFNO_001 sequence. b. Using the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program, add a new record. c. The "ClientDataSet: Must apply updates before refreshing data" error is displayed. This is not captured in the tracer clearly.
It seems the CLINICAL_INDICATION_SCHEME, CLINICAL_CODES, ITEM table records are looped through for each record in the ITEM_CI_SCHEME table to load the info in the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program.
Fix Expectation To improve the tracer time. To include the error clearly in the trace log when non-unique ICIS_REFNO was used to create the new record.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Fine Tune the Loading Performance for the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe Program
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Reporting an issue with the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program.
 
Client Code: SKH
Program: ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe
Program version: 9.8.11.349
Issue Priority: Medium
Master Ticket #: 
 
Issue Description
When tracing the adding new record error in the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program, it takes around 35 minutes to complete the tracer.
There are 555 records in the ITEM_CI_SCHEME.
 
Also, the error (ICIS_REFNO not unique) was not clearly included in the tracer log.
To replicate this error:
a. Manually insert a ICIS_REFNO which is lesser than/within the MX_ICISREFNO_001 sequence.
b. Using the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program, add a new record.
c. The "ClientDataSet: Must apply updates before refreshing data" error is displayed. This is not captured in the tracer clearly.
 
It seems the CLINICAL_INDICATION_SCHEME, CLINICAL_CODES, ITEM table records are looped through for each record in the  ITEM_CI_SCHEME table to load the info in the ItemClinicIndicEligibleSchemeMasterSet_upE.exe program.
 
Fix Expectation
To improve the tracer time.
To include the error clearly in the trace log when non-unique ICIS_REFNO was used to create the new record.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Jade Lau <jlau32@adeahub.co> Sent: Friday, December 5, 2025 11:55 AM To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co> Cc: Salma Banu <salma.banu@adeahub.co> Subject: RE: CUST1395706-Med not dispensed in Maxcare appeared and billed in OAS (Sxxxx569A) HI Alex, I did not save the scripts when I checked the other day. Below is my preliminary analysis based on the data available: OUTQ / Edit Blob Check I only found one DFTP03 (CG status – sent) for the affected observation number. There is no corresponding CA message for the same observation number. This already indicates a potential gap where Maxcare did not generate or send the CA message after CG. IHST Status IHST contains both SL and SR, and both were fully returned. This means Maxcare did not progress or generate the next expected outbound HL7 return message. PTSR / TRDS PTSR status is N, so there should be no TRDS entry, i did not check TRDS. Please kindly verify that. The order was intervened, I noticed the indication in the PTSR. Encounter Data Only one DS encounter was created in that period, and the user ID matches the one in IHST. The concern is that the OUTQ created date/time is not close to the encounter end time. This suggests that some user action (edit, save, remove & re-add, etc.) happened between the encounter closure and the OUTQ creation. Possible Scenario Since Maxcare only produced the CG message and no CA message, and HL7 returns (SL/SR) were fully processed, this looks like a Maxcare internal update issue, likely triggered by unusual user workflow, e.g.: Record created for script 1 → change to script 2→ back to the script 1à edited the record (not the qty but maybe other details)→ removed the record Recommended Checks You can perform these to confirm the user’s actions and reconstruct the sequence: (a) IHST Filter by user ID Add date/time range = Encounter start to encounter end This will show all user actions and movements of drugs/items (add, edit, remove). (b) BLTX (a_billing_transaction / billing_transaction) Any saved record written into IHST must also create a BLTX entry. By listing all BLTX created in the same visit, you can see: What transactions were triggered Whether any record was added/removed multiple times Whether the workflow is abnormal
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Jade Lau <jlau32@adeahub.co> 
 Sent: Friday, December 5, 2025 11:55 AM
 To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co>
 Cc: Salma Banu <salma.banu@adeahub.co>
 Subject: RE: CUST1395706-Med not dispensed in Maxcare appeared and billed in OAS (Sxxxx569A)
 
HI Alex,
 
I did not save the scripts when I checked the other day. Below is my preliminary analysis based on the data available:
 
  1. OUTQ / Edit Blob Check
  • I only found one DFTP03 (CG status – sent) for the affected observation number.
  • There is no corresponding CA message for the same observation number.
  • This already indicates a potential gap where Maxcare did not generate or send the CA message after CG.
  1. IHST Status
  • IHST contains both SL and SR, and both were fully returned.
  • This means Maxcare did not progress or generate the next expected outbound HL7 return message.
  1. PTSR / TRDS
  • PTSR status is N, so there should be no TRDS entry, i did not check TRDS.  Please kindly verify that.
  • The order was intervened, I noticed the indication in the PTSR.
 
  1. Encounter Data
    • Only one DS encounter was created in that period, and the user ID matches the one in IHST.

    • The concern is that the OUTQ created date/time is not close to the encounter end time.

      • This suggests that some user action (edit, save, remove & re-add, etc.) happened between the encounter closure and the OUTQ creation.
  1. Possible Scenario
    • Since Maxcare only produced the CG message and no CA message, and HL7 returns (SL/SR) were fully processed, this looks like a Maxcare internal update issue, likely triggered by unusual user workflow, e.g.:
      • Record created for script 1 → change to script 2→ back to the script 1à edited the record (not the qty but maybe other details)→ removed the record 
  1. Recommended Checks
     You can perform these to confirm the user’s actions and reconstruct the sequence:
(a) IHST
    • Filter by user ID
    • Add date/time range = Encounter start to encounter end
    • This will show all user actions and movements of drugs/items (add, edit, remove).
(b) BLTX (a_billing_transaction / billing_transaction)
    • Any saved record written into IHST must also create a BLTX entry.
    • By listing all BLTX created in the same visit, you can see:
      • What transactions were triggered
      • Whether any record was added/removed multiple times
      • Whether the workflow is abnormal

Dear JiaYng
We’re unable to find the root cause of this issue. We’re suggesting reporting this issue if it occurs again to have more information.
Issue Summary We had an issue here at SNEC. Med that was not dispensed appeared & charged in OAS (please refer to attached). Please help to find out what’s happening.
Dear SingHealth-SNEC OAS Support team, request your help see able to find out any timeline whether the Naviblef interface in then interface out OR not interfaced out OR …?
Timeline: 12th Nov:
* The prescription interfaced in at 11:57am. My colleague Michelle wrote a remark and saved it at 12:04:52pm. * But frontline checked, Naviblef flowed into that OAS visit at 12:03+pm.. (ie ~ 6 mins after Rx interface into Maxcare and before Michelle finished the remarks)
13th Nov:
* the bill was finalised around 2:48pm, via RPA.
Question: how does Naviblef appeared when we never do anything?
Best regards
Yong Koon Win (Win) Application Deployment Management Specialist

When we cancel the claim from ‘RCM transaction’ screen then system sending the adjudication status that Cancel Failed and E$!^Error$!^$!^RE-00133 | Task focus is not referring to a valid resource. when we cancel the claim from RCM transaction screen, its not getting called and Interface team triaged it and found the below.. In the "SET_PAYER_PREAUTH_HEADER" procedure, "P_INT_REQUEST_ID" parameter is received as NULL from BILLING.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-SCF-0426: Cancel claim not working.
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
NMC-JD-SCF-0426: Cancel claim not working.
When we cancel the claim from ‘RCM transaction’ screen then system sending the adjudication status that Cancel Failed and E$!^Error$!^$!^RE-00133 | Task focus is not referring to a valid resource.
when we cancel the claim from RCM transaction screen, its not getting called and Interface team triaged it and found the below..
In the "SET_PAYER_PREAUTH_HEADER" procedure, "P_INT_REQUEST_ID" parameter is received as NULL from BILLING.

helpdesk-ticket.description: NMC-JD-SCF-0425: 1) System is not picking the correct security certificate of the requested facility when the multiple poll jobs are running. Because of this below error being thrown. Nphies Operation Outcome : http://nphies.sa/terminology/CodeSystem/adjudication-error -- GE-00020 -- The sender's credentials does not match the message sender. 2) System is not fetching the correct Facility id which is equivalent to the facility in the Poll response. Nphies API Error Response :: 400 Bad Request 3) System is failing to generate the request json files for some claims requests when claims submitted for multiple facilities at a time. 4) System throwing error that not able to update the xh-payer-auth-detail
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NMC-JD-SCF-0425 : NPHIES Claims : Interface issues when multiple facilities submitted claims
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
NMC-JD-SCF-0425:  1) System is not picking the correct security certificate of the requested facility when the multiple poll jobs are running. Because of this below error being thrown.
Nphies Operation Outcome : http://nphies.sa/terminology/CodeSystem/adjudication-error -- GE-00020 -- The sender's credentials does not match the message sender.
2) System is not fetching the correct Facility id which is equivalent to the facility in the Poll response. 
Nphies API Error Response :: 400 Bad Request
3) System is failing to generate the request json files for some claims requests when claims submitted for multiple facilities at a time. 
4) System throwing error that not able to update the xh-payer-auth-detail

helpdesk-ticket.description: SERVICE PAYABLE Legend is not showing the correct package value in Interim bill ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Steps – Apply some package on any patient Add some cosmetic items having taxes. So that all the items in the bill gets added with tax Now associate that package from mod fin details Now open the interim bill of that patient – the SERVICE PAYABLE legend will not show the package value with addition of tax. Created this SCF on behalf of KDAH-CRF-0624.1
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SERVICE PAYABLE Legend is not showing the correct package value in Intermediate Draft Report
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
SERVICE PAYABLE Legend is not showing the correct package value in Interim bill
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Steps –
  1. Apply some package on any patient
  2. Add some cosmetic items having taxes. So that all the items in the bill gets added with tax
  3. Now associate that package from mod fin details
  4. Now open the interim bill of that patient – the SERVICE PAYABLE legend will not show the package value with addition of tax.
Created this SCF on behalf of KDAH-CRF-0624.1

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Nur Syafiqah Bt Sidek, We do not see any issues with the Number of Patients Carried Forward From the Previous Day - Distribution by Specialty in Ward, as the count for each specialty on 27/08/2025 is correct and matches the Total Number Of Patients At 12 Midnight By Class on 26/08/2025. The Number of Admissions - Distribution by Specialty in Ward from 26/08/2025 to 28/08/2025 is also correct and matches the admission list in PD 101. However, we noticed a data discrepancy between the Number of Patients Carried Forward From the Previous Day (for General Surgery and Orthopaedics) on 28/08/2025 and the Total Number Of Patients At 12 Midnight By Class for 27/08/2025. We will proceed to correct this issue. You may refer to the attached data comparison document for your reference. Please advise if there are any other issues that we may have missed. ​ Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Nur Syafiqah Bt Sidek,

We do not see any issues with the Number of Patients Carried Forward From the Previous Day - Distribution by Specialty in Ward, as the count for each specialty on 27/08/2025 is correct and matches the Total Number Of Patients At 12 Midnight By Class on 26/08/2025. The Number of Admissions - Distribution by Specialty in Ward from 26/08/2025 to 28/08/2025 is also correct and matches the admission list in PD 101.

However, we noticed a data discrepancy between the Number of Patients Carried Forward From the Previous Day (for General Surgery and Orthopaedics) on 28/08/2025 and the Total Number Of Patients At 12 Midnight By Class for 27/08/2025. We will proceed to correct this issue.

You may refer to the attached data comparison document for your reference.
Please advise if there are any other issues that we may have missed. ​



Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Related to test proof provided for MST0086647 / CUST0865977. The issue #2 raised in the test proof which is not address and SGH comments the current behavior is not correct. SGH UAT Issue #38 - The script number is updated to the merged script number in prescription tab after delete. SGH listed 6 scenarios and expected results as below:
Script No shown under ‘Script’
Current behaviour
Expected behaviours: Update to the script no that the item was last partial dispensed into If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No
Scenario 1: Item has not been dispensed before
Same as Original Script No
Same as Original Script No
Scenario 2: Continue from Scenario 1, Perform 1st partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 3: Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed), Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item returns to not been dispensed before
Update to same as Original Script No
Update to same as Original Script No
Scenario 4: Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed), Perform 2nd partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Scenario 5: Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed), Delete item from 2nd partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item has been dispensed before (1st partial dispense)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into (May have been voided under the visit that item was dispensed into)
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 6: Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed), Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab) Item has been dispensed before (2nd partial dispense)
(Did not test)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Jade 23 Oct 2025: Will raise an issue log for it. We understand that the expected behaviour is to record the last script number used for dispensing in the prescription tab when there are remaining balances, based on the defined scenarios. If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No. A development analysis will be required to assess the feasibility of this request Irvin 28/10/2025: May I clarify if the behaviours described are existing in current Production v369? Otherwise, noted to raise issue log (and development analysis to assess feasibility of fix to achieve the expected behaviour). Will add addressing this issue as condition for sign-off. Jade 29 Oct 2025:- The fix is to allow dispensed to visit that is not closed. The script does not update to original script number is an existing behavior in v369.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH UAT Issue #38 - The script number is updated to the merged script number in prescription tab after delete.
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Related to test proof provided for MST0086647 / CUST0865977.  The issue #2 raised in the test proof which is not address and SGH comments the current behavior is not correct.
SGH UAT Issue #38 - The script number is updated to the merged script number in prescription tab after delete.
SGH listed 6 scenarios and expected results as below:
 
 
Script No shown under ‘Script’
Current behaviour
Expected behaviours:
Update to the script no that the item was last partial dispensed into
If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No
Scenario 1:
Item has not been dispensed before
Same as Original Script No
Same as Original Script No
Scenario 2:
Continue from Scenario 1,
Perform 1st partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 3:
Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item returns to not been dispensed before
Update to same as Original Script No
Update to same as Original Script No
Scenario 4:
Continue from Scenario 2 (after 1st partial dispense performed),
Perform 2nd partial dispense
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Update to the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Scenario 5:
Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 2nd partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item has been dispensed before (1st partial dispense)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into (May have been voided under the visit that item was dispensed into)
Update to the script no that the item was 1st partial dispensed into
Scenario 6:
Continue from Scenario 4 (after 1st and 2nd partial dispense performed),
Delete item from 1st partial dispense (return to Prescription tab)
Item has been dispensed before (2nd partial dispense)
(Did not test)
Remain as the script no that the item was 2nd partial dispensed into
Jade 23 Oct 2025:   Will raise an issue log for it.  We understand that the expected behaviour is to record the last script number used for dispensing in the prescription tab when there are remaining balances, based on the defined scenarios. If item has not been dispensed before, update to Original Script No.   A development analysis will be required to assess the feasibility of this request
Irvin 28/10/2025: May I clarify if the behaviours described are existing in current Production v369?
Otherwise, noted to raise issue log (and development analysis to assess feasibility of fix to achieve the expected behaviour). Will add addressing this issue as condition for sign-off.
Jade 29 Oct 2025:-  The fix is to allow dispensed to visit that is not closed.  The script does not update to original script number is an existing behavior in v369.

helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
During the GHL-CRF-0673.1 Testing in UAT, Functionality is working fine but showing popups which are not required or should not be shown. Please find below the details:
  1. Warning Screen before actual Error Screen:

Only error screen should be shown
  2. Please acknowledge screen: When user clicks on Display and Validate button in Blood Unit Screening Result Entry a popup 'Please acknowledge' is shown

helpdesk-ticket.description:
For last 6 years since I have joined Medanta, this area has remained a puzzle to me which I have neither been able to comprehend nor find a reliable solution. Our teams across locations struggle day and night to address this unknown monster which shows up anytime, anywhere and then none of us know what we need to do. We follow all possible protocols: Reinstall drivers on printers and servers Reinstall fonts of printers, servers and routing desktops Rename print share names Adding / removing mapping of printers in HIS tables Change print server Move print queue from one server to another Restart spooler Reboot servers Remove print servers and install newly built servers And so on
Everything is Hit and trial, by virtue of some steps one type of report start printing other gets stuck. Lab barcodes start printing Patient label gets stuck , same thing working on one floor not working on another, so on and so forth.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3021: Print routing issues- Medanta
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
For last 6 years since I have joined Medanta, this area has remained a puzzle to me which I have neither been able to comprehend nor find a reliable solution.
Our teams across locations struggle day and night to address this unknown monster which shows up anytime, anywhere and then none of us know what we need to do. We follow all possible protocols:
Reinstall drivers on printers and servers
Reinstall fonts of printers, servers and routing desktops
Rename print share names
Adding / removing mapping of printers in HIS tables
Change print server
Move print queue from one server to another
Restart spooler
Reboot servers
Remove print servers and install newly built servers
And so on
 
Everything is Hit and trial, by virtue of some steps one type of report start printing other gets stuck. Lab barcodes start printing Patient label gets stuck , same thing working on one floor not working on another, so on and so forth.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Between above grid and below grid, there is an option to show Package Description and there is ample of space still package name is completely visible. helpdesk-ticket.description: Services should be directly visible, but in this case Enterprise groups are being displayed on the screen, and for users to verify what services they are going to bill is double work as users will not open groups and then check the services for billing. If there are so many services group charged, then on bill generation screen, when we scroll headers also start to shatter. Option column by defaults should be select and non-mandatory, as by default it is pending interim bill and when user opts for final bill generation, must change the option from grid- extra click for user. When we scroll to check package details in below grid then header gets removed, it should be fixed.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3014: Issue in RBU-GHL-CRF-0022 – Bill Generation (Usability Issue)
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
• Services should be directly visible, but in this case Enterprise groups are being displayed on the screen, and for users to verify what services they are going to bill is double work as users will not open groups and then check the services for billing.
  • If there are so many services group charged, then on bill generation screen, when we scroll headers also start to shatter.
  • Option column by defaults should be select and non-mandatory, as by default it is pending interim bill and when user opts for final bill generation, must change the option from grid- extra click for user.
  • When we scroll to check package details in below grid then header gets removed, it should be fixed.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Inconsistent result obtained for TROD_QUANTITY_RECEIVED, it is showing Y while other time is null. When TROD_QUANTITY_RECEIVED is updated to Y, it is because the quantity from the SCM message is translated successfully. However, during my testing with the same messages, the quantity was translated inconsistently — sometimes it was translated successfully, and other times it was not. I found that the behaviour is related to the orders preceding the freetext. If the item before the freetext is a 'tablet', the order is mapped to an item and translated successfully, the freetext order follows immediately after is also having sent in qty with UOM 'tablet', the quantity of the free text order would be translated and TROD_QUANTITY_RECEIVED would be updated to Y. Please look into the scm msg processing logic for free text orders. All these are free text order with similar messages used. The qty is translated sometime but not all the time.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH UAT issue #18- Free text order with Qty sent in msg. SCM dll processing logic inconsistent.

helpdesk-ticket.description: OPAS team found the Original Dispense Quantity field was at the wrong position (ZXO[20]) of the ZXO segment for the drug COLCHICINE 500MCG TAB in the HL7 message. After checking the received HL7 message from SCM, it's found in the Instructions field of the RXO & OBX segment there is a character sequence, \F\, which indicates the "|" (pipe) character of the message. Maxcare have converted this as the pipe character & stored in the table. When sending the dispense information to the OPAS system, Maxcre have included this pipe character into the ZXO segment which has caused the Original Dispense Quantity field to be at the wrong position. Since the handling of the character sequence in the instruction was not discussed in the functional specifications, this is considered as a change request.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Change Request - To Manage the Character Sequence in HL7 Message Received from SCM & Sent to OPAS
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
OPAS team found the Original Dispense Quantity field was at the wrong position (ZXO[20]) of the ZXO segment for the drug COLCHICINE 500MCG TAB in the HL7 message.
After checking the received HL7 message from SCM, it's found in the Instructions field of the RXO & OBX segment there is a character sequence, \F\, which indicates the "|" (pipe) character of the message.
Maxcare have converted this as the pipe character & stored in the table. When sending the dispense information to the OPAS system, Maxcre have included this pipe character into the ZXO segment which has caused the Original Dispense Quantity field to be at the wrong position.
Since the handling of the character sequence in the instruction was not discussed in the functional specifications, this is considered as a change request.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Hi Dedalus support team,
SGH user reported a case where user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another user is accessing visit at Dispensing Module.
Noticed the following unexpected behaviours highlighted in yellow. Seeking clarification on whether any of these behaviours would be incorrect and should be fixed.
Ÿ E-Rx SGH-25-12499521 for 0004-88-053-G, Ordered Qty calculated as 189 TAB, to round up to 190 TAB (sales multiple 10) at the dispensing pharmacy Ÿ User 1 partial dispensed 90 TAB Item History: Qty Out 190 then Qty In 100 Ÿ Not known if the following actions had occurred concurrently § User 2 reset encounter § User 1 F7 >> Send interface messages to SCM (medication dispensed), Fastrak (pick 90 tab), and OAS (bill 90 tab) Ÿ User 2, open visit, and delete the dispensed transaction of 90 TAB Item History: Qty In 100 then Qty In 90 Ÿ When User 2 F7, no interface message generated to send to SCM (to clear Medication Dispensed status), Fastrak (cancel picking) or OAS (cancel bill 90 tab) Ÿ No stuck transaction seen at SendCancelDeleteMsg utility program (presumably, means not found at PSMM table). No messages is not created to send to SCM, fastrak and OAS for the transaction performed by User 2.
For your investigation and clarification for this scenario. Thank you.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH PROD- No message send to SCM, Fastrak and OAS after user performs reset encounter
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Hi Dedalus support team,
 
SGH user reported a case where user inappropriately performs reset encounter when another user is accessing visit at Dispensing Module.
 
Noticed the following unexpected behaviours highlighted in yellow. Seeking clarification on whether any of these behaviours would be incorrect and should be fixed.
 
Ÿ E-Rx SGH-25-12499521 for 0004-88-053-G, Ordered Qty calculated as 189 TAB, to round up to 190 TAB (sales multiple 10) at the dispensing pharmacy
Ÿ User 1 partial dispensed 90 TAB
Item History: Qty Out 190 then Qty In 100
Ÿ Not known if the following actions had occurred concurrently
§ User 2 reset encounter
§ User 1 F7 >> Send interface messages to SCM (medication dispensed), Fastrak (pick 90 tab), and OAS (bill 90 tab)
Ÿ User 2, open visit, and delete the dispensed transaction of 90 TAB
Item History: Qty In 100 then Qty In 90
Ÿ When User 2 F7, no interface message generated to send to SCM (to clear Medication Dispensed status), Fastrak (cancel picking) or OAS (cancel bill 90 tab)
Ÿ No stuck transaction seen at SendCancelDeleteMsg utility program (presumably, means not found at PSMM table). No messages is not created to send to SCM, fastrak and OAS for the transaction performed by User 2.
 
 
 
For your investigation and clarification for this scenario. Thank you.

helpdesk-note.body: From: Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@adeahub.co> Sent: Thursday, February 19, 2026 12:26 To: Saravanan Ramamurthy <sramamurthy7@adeahub.co>; Yong Koon Win <koonwin.yong@adeahub.co> Subject: Re: MST0106367 - NHCS - Pending OAS messages Hi Alex, After analysing the issue, we did not find any deadlock information logged in the Oracle reports you shared. We propose the following two possible solutions: As discussed earlier over the Teams chat, please include the Z01 segment and its related details in the SWHL7MsgRulesDef.txt and SWHL7SegmentDef.txt configuration files. This will help prevent the error message “critical error: Z01 is an invalid segment” from being written to the log file. The Oracle report indicates that the PTOR SELECT script is experiencing performance slowness. To address this, we will provide an index creation script in version 9.8.11.384 to improve SQL execution time and overall performance. [Correction] An index creation script '1974_CREATE_INDEX_PTOR_SCRIPT_UPDATE_DATE_PRN_N_FOR_PATIENT_ORIGINAL_RX.sql' has been released in version 9.8.11.384. Kindly execute the script and monitor the OAS INQ performance. Kindly implement the above-mentioned solutions and monitor the OAS INQ performance accordingly.

  1. The Oracle report indicates that the PTOR SELECT script is experiencing performance slowness. To address this, we will provide an index creation script in version 9.8.11.384 to improve SQL execution time and overall performance.
